title: MAKE ADJACENCY MATRIX OF A CIFTI LABEL FILE
description: Find face-adjacent voxels and connected vertices that have different label values, and count them for each pair.  Put the resulting counts into a parcellated connectivity file, with the diagonal being zero.  This gives a rough estimate of how long or expansive the border between two labels is.

adjacency_out.description: the output cifti pconn adjacency matrix

left_surface.description: specify the left surface to use

right_surface.description: specify the right surface to use

cerebellum_surface.description: specify the cerebellum surface to use
